audit.why: Difficulty framing matches the kit: Trundle bullies levels 1-3 with Chomp, Aatrox equalises at 3 with the full Q+W+E chain, and the lane becomes cooldown-gated on World Ender. Side-lane and teamfight framing is right (Trundle splits with Frozen Domain, Aatrox brawls).
audit.corrected: Kept the early-bully / R-gated framing; sharpened Level 3 to name the actual blocker (Umbral Dash) instead of a vague 'disengage'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text names World Ender and Trinity Force but attaches no cooldown numbers, so 'when Aatrox commits his World Ender' has no timer behind it.
audit.why: World Ender is 120/100/80 and Subjugate is 120/100/80 — identical at rank 1, which is why the two-ultimate window is a race and not a coin flip. The Darkin Blade is 14s at rank 1, the longest punishable window in the lane.
audit.corrected: Added the 120s R-vs-R symmetry and the 14s Q window to the spike, why and phase text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive kit interaction is never stated: Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain and Umbral Dash (E, 9/8/7/6/5) is Aatrox's only repositioning tool. Text said 'Pillar behind Aatrox to deny disengage' without naming his dash. World Ender's healing amplification is only implied by a generic 'anti-heal' line.
audit.why: Riot's Pillar of Ice text is explicit that it becomes impassable terrain; Umbral Dash is a directional dash. Placing the pillar on his dash lane removes his only exit or re-entry for 9 seconds at rank 1. World Ender's description states it grants increased healing, which is what makes Grievous Wounds mandatory rather than optional.
audit.corrected: Named Umbral Dash and its 9s cooldown as the thing Pillar denies, and stated World Ender's healing amplification as the reason for Executioner's Calling.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed two Aatrox abilities with no durations, so there was no window to play around.
audit.why: The Darkin Blade is 14s at rank 1 and Umbral Dash 9s at rank 1 — those two numbers decide when you can walk at him.
Executioner's Calling on first back is already listed and is correct — Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash and World Ender all heal, which the interaction file flags as the anti-heal matchup.

edits.before: Subjugate when World Ender pops — you drain half his resists mid-fight and Frozen Domain's healing on top makes this Trundle's cleanest all-in window all game.
edits.after: Subjugate the second World Ender pops — the steal doubles over 4s, so R first and fight the rest on his own stats. Both ultimates are 120s at rank 1: a straight race.

edits.before: Pillar behind Aatrox when he tries to disengage a losing trade, cutting off his retreat so your healing and AS advantage finish the job
edits.after: Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain — put it on his Umbral Dash lane, not on his body, and his only exit is gone for 9 seconds

edits.before: Pop World Ender when you are between cooldowns so his drain-heal outpaces your King's Tribute regen
edits.after: Pop World Ender for its healing amp so Umbral Dash outdrains King's Tribute before you own Grievous

edits.before: Once Aatrox has Q+W+E he can chain his outer-Q sweetspots around your pillar and drain-trade back — this is his first real equaliser and the lane becomes coin-flip if you brawl straight up.
edits.after: Once Aatrox has Q+W+E he chains outer-Q sweetspots and Infernal Chains drags you back into them — his first real equaliser. The Darkin Blade is 14s at rank 1, so three missed swings gift you the window.

edits.before: Pillar closes the kit — use it behind Aatrox to deny disengage, or between you and World Ender to break his pattern.
edits.after: Pillar is impassable terrain — drop it on his Umbral Dash lane and the 9s dash he needs to enter or leave is dead.

edits.before: - Aatrox World Ender: matchup-defining — His drain spike. Anti-heal and out-duel it in your W. Track it before every engage. - Aatrox The Darkin Blade: Three swings; the outer-edge sweetspot knocks up and deals heavy damage. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Aatrox World Ender: 120s at rank 1 — amplifies his healing, so Grievous Wounds is mandatory. Track it before every engage. - Aatrox The Darkin Blade: 14s at rank 1; three swings, outer edge knocks up. All three miss and you own 14 seconds.

edits.before: Aatrox wastes World Ender — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Aatrox wastes World Ender — commit now, and open with Subjugate.

edits.before: Track Aatrox's World Ender: His drain spike. Anti-heal and out-duel it in your W. When it is down — Bite + duel him.
edits.after: Track World Ender (120s): it amps his healing, so hold Grievous Wounds. Pillar his Umbral Dash lane (9s) — no exit.
